verdicts.reason: Both share the same flaws: the headline wraps awkwardly (MODERN alone on a line, then FURNITURE DESIGN, then FESTIVAL), runs almost into the left canvas edge, and sits on the busy photo; the bottom third is dead image space. A keeps the blue and black boxes interlocked as one stacked group, as in the original. B leaves an arbitrary gap between them, so the photo shows through, the two boxes read as separate fragments, and the cluster ends up lower and less balanced.
